basis_decomposition_crlb — TOMOGRAPHY spectral_xray op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.basis_decomposition_crlb(thickness_cm=(5.0, 0.0), basis=('WATER', 'AL'), channels=None, photons_per_pixel: 'float' = 100000.0) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import dualxray; dualxray.basis_decomposition_crlb(thickness_cm=(5.0, 0.0), basis=('WATER', 'AL'), channels=None, photons_per_pixel: 'float' = 100000.0) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opstomography.get("basis_decomposition_crlb"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Return in closed form the lower bound (Cramér–Rao) on the variance of the decomposition at basis thicknesses b.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

Fisher 情報 F = Σ_c (1/var_c) ∇mean_c ∇mean_cᵀ、∂mean_c/∂b_j = −n₀ Σ_k W g μ_j e^{−μ·b} (計数では var_c = mean_c で Poisson の Fisher 情報そのもの、Roessl & Herrmann 2009 の式)。CRLB = F⁻¹。返り値: dict(cov (B, B) [cm²], sigma_cm (B,), correlation, expected (C,), basis, condition(F の条件数 —— 2 つの基底の μ(E) が似ているほど大きい))。F が特異(チャネル < 基底、または同じ材料を 2 回)なら ValueError。
